title: virusScan is declared as an own capability the input TAC calls; the applied verifier is elicited per project
description: The blueprint declares `virusScan` in `capabilities` and the input TAC calls the applied verifier as an async predicate over a File that resolves to `{clean: true}` or `{clean: false, reason: <string>}`. A project supplies the verifier (or elicits the noop verifier and accepts the risk per ADR-2403). The refusal path on a virus-scan hit fires on the input TAC and the refused file never leaves the browser.
rationale: ADR-2403 contributes virusScan but the manifest declared no capability; declaring it as an own capability with a must REQ closes the seam.
